# Pre-PR Review

**Arguments:** "$ARGUMENTS"

1. Find the Orc-istration checkout: the "Setup checkout (this machine)" line in the rulebook's tool notes, else `setupCheckout` in `config.json` (under `ORC_DATA_DIR` when set, else under `~/.orc/`), else ask the user. Call it CHECKOUT and confirm `CHECKOUT/review/PROCEDURE.md` exists there; if it does not, stop and say so.
2. Read `CHECKOUT/review/PROCEDURE.md` and follow it with these arguments. Dispatch each explorer and the verifier by its roster name as `subagent_type`, never `general-purpose`; launch all selected explorers in one message, each with `run_in_background: true`, so they run in parallel; pass a tier override as `model:` (the Tiers line of the tool notes maps tiers to models); resume an explorer with SendMessage; ask the developer with `AskUserQuestion`. A role that `review/PROCEDURE.md` "Routed agents" sends to another tool is the exception: run it with `orc dispatch` in the shell as that section says.
